2.69.2 Table.Style
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.Style element specifies the style information for a Table. This element is optional and is of
type Style.
Following is the parent element of the Table.Style element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
